settled_rulings_not_reasked: Na/Li may discharge within the same hour.
Chemical preference is level4 after all three service objectives, never critical epsilon or level1b.
S-base is grid-first, renewable surplus charging and grid top-up capped at soc_ref under the current rule.
Window-input lookahead/preprocessing is permitted; optimization is not.
parallel=true ratios use power caps, not SOC energy limits.

remaining_findings.finding: Capping all charging at soc_ref prevents correcting a final-hour forced discharge. It does not guarantee terminal equality for the newly required grid-capacity-binding cases.

constant_grid_cap_counterexample.scope: Real normal S-cost feasibility witness; not an S-base result. No YAML changed. This case uses a constant grid cap and a valid hard-deadline task.

remaining_findings.interpretation: The final-hour deficit is physically serviceable, and a real normal MILP reaches the required terminal SOC. S-base alone forbids the necessary earlier precharge above soc_ref. This is rule-induced terminal infeasibility, not inadequate total hardware capacity.
remaining_findings.decision_needed: Either specify a bounded terminal-reserve/precharge exception, or explicitly accept/report this baseline-policy infeasibility. Do not label its unavoidable terminal deficit an implementation bug.

remaining_findings.finding: The same section prohibits all normal infeasible results but explicitly orders an infeasible result for a1h1.35MW load with0.5MW grid and no storage.
remaining_findings.scope: The physical-shortfall diagnostic rule is already clear and is not being re-asked. The unconditional never-infeasible wording must be scoped to avoid contradicting that explicit exception. It also cannot be used to conceal V28-1.

remaining_findings.finding: The space above soc_ref is physically usable under the symmetric band; excluding it is an S-base policy choice, not a capacity fact.
remaining_findings.counterexample: gamma=.5, soc_ref=.5 and nominal[.1,.9] give band[.3,.7]. The upper half is available for charging. Actual middle-scenario Na parameters at20C give band[.1032,.8968].
remaining_findings.scope: Do not propagate the S-base policy cap into global usable_band or the other four strategies.
